name: Partition Functions and Free Energy
equations: S = -\left(\frac{\partial F}{\partial T}\right)_V = k_B(\ln Z + \beta U)
methods: Sum over all energy states or integrate over phase space with Boltzmann factor
Factorize partition function into translational, vibrational, rotational components
Compute Helmholtz free energy F = -kT ln Z
Differentiate F or ln Z with respect to beta, T, or V to obtain thermodynamic observables
problem_types: Thermodynamics of quantum harmonic oscillator ensemble (Einstein solid)
Rotational and vibrational partition functions of diatomic gases
Magnetization and susceptibility of non-interacting magnetic dipoles
pitfalls: Summing over energy levels without including their degeneracies g_i: Z = sum g_i e^(-beta E_i)
Failing to divide by N! for indistinguishable independent particles: Z_N = (Z_1)^N / N!
references: Kardar Statistical Physics of Particles Ch.4
